User (9.2s): The last four digits are twenty-two eighty-eight

First, your credit card ending 2288 has a past-due amount of 220.00, which is 9 days late. Second, your personal loan has a past-due amount of 640.00, which is 9 days late. Third, your car loan has a past-due amount of 75.00, which is 3 days late. Can you pay all of them today?

User (16.4s): I cannot pay today. I can pay all three this Friday.

Assistant (19.1s): To confirm: you will pay 220.00 for the credit card ending 2288 on Friday 16 October 2026; and 640.00 for the personal loan on Friday 16 October 2026; and 75.00 for the car loan on Friday 16 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (20.3s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (22.2s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (34.9s): Thank you. Your promise of 220.00 for the credit card ending 2288 on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. Your promise of 640.00 for the personal loan on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. Your promise of 75.00 for the car loan on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
